name: set_timer
description: Manage countdown timers. Use when the user says 'set a timer for 10 minutes', 'cancel the timer', or asks how long is left. Starting a timer opens the TIMERS widget on the HUD and a notification with sound fires when it completes.

parameters.description: start = begin a new countdown. cancel = stop a running timer. list = report active timers.
Timer duration in minutes (may be fractional, e.g. 0.5 for 30 seconds). Required for start.
Optional short label like 'pasta' or 'print check'. Also used to match which timer to cancel.
